messages:
Sam: PTAL — I pushed fixes for the serialization bug you called out in #9876. 
Sam: - added unit + integration test 
Sam: - split the big test into two files so CI isn't a flake 
Sam: - updated CHANGELOG with a one-liner and noted the fallback behavior on cache miss
Sam: Would like to get this merged before tomorrow's canary (trying to hit the 18:00 PST window).

Jordan: Quick skim - this looks good. couple tiny nits inline about variable names and one comment typo. nothing blocking.

Sam: Thanks—fixed the nits, renamed tracked->tracking and pushed.

Priya: Small question: does the new codepath change dedupe semantics for seq len == 0? I remember a flake around empty sequences.

Sam: Good call. I added an explicit unit for seq len==0 and did not change dedupe logic — the diff isolates serialization only. Test added:

```
def test_serialize_empty_sequence():
    x = ModelState([])
    out = serialize(x)
    assert out == b''
```

Sam: CI is green locally and remote CI is passing the new integration job.

Lee: Can you also request squash when you merge? We want a single commit for release notes tooling. Also, add a changelog bullet under "runtime" not "infra".

Sam: Done — commit message set to "fix(serialization): avoid None in kv encoding (test+changelog)" and added changelog under runtime. Re-requesting review @Jordan @Priya — PTAL again?

Jordan: Approved :+1: — happy to merge once the second approve is in.

Priya: Approved. Sorry for the delay, was on customer calls.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z if merged by 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z.

Sam: I'll merge in 30m unless there's an objection. Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround :tada:
